notes.title: Long Steel Update 1.2
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p][/p][p]It's been longer than I originally anticipated, but I'm happy to announce that the 1.2 update for Long Steel is officially out now! This update brings with it 2 new areas with lots of new content including new achievements, songs and boss battles![/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Return to the Instant Launch Format[/u][/b][/p][p][/p][p]In order to prevent high CPU usage by the engine, the game was making use of a separate launcher. Thanks to a discovery by the Solarus Team, they've found a way for the instant launch .exe file to no longer take up an intense amount of CPU! Thanks to this, players will be able to launch Long Steel without having to navigate a secondary launcher and will also experience less CPU related crashes.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]General[/u][/b][/p][p][/p][p]-Various bug fixes throughout the game[/p][p]-New graveyard cutscene following the third boss[/p][p]-Changes to cutscene dialogs/events where deemed appropriate[/p][p]-Rolling without walking will cause the hero to pivot backwards[/p][p]-New small animation occurs where teleporting between warp points[/p][p]-World map has been added to the Palelands[/p][p]-Birds are more abundant in the world and will usually have bird nests nearby that drop Eggs[/p][p]-Bombs and Exploding Rocks blow up upon impact with lava and water[/p][p]-Cleaner UI[/p][p]-Made the sword slightly longer [/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Slime Kingdom[/u][/b][/p][p][/p][p]It's the Slime Princeling's first birthday! And to celebrate, the Slime Queen is throwing a very special birthday party! ... But oh no! Thieves have invaded the party and stole some of the ingredients! Help the chefs get back these ingredients and help save the Princeling's birthday! [/p][p][/p][p]To access the Slime Kingdom, make your way to the Town Square and talk to Duke Slimington located next to the Cake Salesman. [/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Goblin Capital[/u][/b][/p][p][/p][p]Upon gaining access to the postgame, head outside your house and you'll find a letter in your mailbox. (Yes, I added a mailbox outside the house specifically for this) Farmer Lin made himself a makeshift boat and is heading to Shipwreck Isle to meet up with his family in the Goblin Capital and he's invited you to come along![/p][p][/p][p]The Goblin Capital has lots of new content throughout including a whole new postgame quest chain, 3 new boss fights and new areas to explore. Complete all of the activities and you'll be able to help fund the Goblin Museum![/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Spelunker's Cave[/u][/b][/p][p][/p][p]On Shipwreck Isle, there is a cave that is said to be littered with buried treasure. A goblin foreman and his crew delved into these caves in search for said treasure, but encountered great difficulties. One of the goblins has gotten stuck at the bottom and they're counting on you for a rescue! Use the Drill to break open rocks to find ladders further down into the caves until you manage to reach the bottom. Once you've gotten there, you'll find yourself face to face with the deadly Giant Treasure Crab! [/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Ghost Ship[/u][/b][/p][p][/p][p]On the eastern outskirts of Shipwreck Isle, there is rumored to be an abandoned old ship, still haunted by the skeletons of the original crew. Certainly there will be great treasure in the Captain's Den... if you can make it there! But even if you do, expect to face stern resistant from the dreaded Pirate Captain...[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Goblin Museum[/u][/b][/p][p][/p][p]Defeating the bosses of the Ghost Ship and Spelunker's Cave along with completing the Goblin Capital quest chain will allow you access to the fully funded and furnished Goblin Museum! This building is filled with lots of new world building and lore related artifacts. You'll also have access to the Aquarium here! It's run by the Melas Aquarium's twin brother who happens to have all of the same lines of dialog! Because that's just how twins operate! (Haha... ha...)[/p][p][/p][p]You will also be able to access the Goblin Cafe. Speak to the barista every day for a different special drink. (Yes, there is a different dialog and sprite associated with every day of the year, including for the leap year. Why did I do this? I'm crazy.)[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Explore through all of the new content to unlock a whipping 9 new achievements! Wow! (Psst, one of these achievements may involve something with those ill-tempered chickens back on Melas. Maybe check that out.)[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]I hope you all enjoy all of the new content that's come along with this new update! In the coming weeks, I'm planning on revisiting the Steam page and breathing some new life into it with a new trailer and new screenshots! Keep an eye out for that! Until next time, as always feel free to email me with any suggestions or bug reports at kyletassonegames@gmail.com! Enjoy the Steam Summer Sale and thanks for reading![/p][p][/p][p]-Kyle[/p]

notes.title: Long Steel Update 1.1.5
notes.content:
Happy Halloween!

It's been a while since the last update, this one I'm labeling 1.1.5 since although it is still a major update that adds and/or changes many things about the game, it's not substantial enough for me to consider 1.2. With that, here's a brief overview of all the new changes being made to Long Steel.

[u][b]Game Launcher[/b][/u]

For the foreseeable future, the Long Steel .exe file will instead be using the Solarus Launcher. While this makes the initial boot-up a bit clunky, it has a much lower toll on the CPU and memory, which should prevent crashes on older systems. For the first time playing, you will need to navigate in the Launcher to
File > Add Quest > The Long Steel .solarus file

This should be temporary up until the newest update for the Solarus engine releases!

[u][b]Cooking Update and Menus[/b][/u]

There are now 6 more recipes that can be cooked up at the Bonfire! They stack the same way other recipes do so be sure to stock up on them before heading into any dungeons!

With this, I have added a new achievement that unlocks when you have cooked at least one of every recipe.

I have also made some graphical changes to the pause menu screens. Some are completely different while some changes are much more subtle. Hopefully this will make everything look cleaner and more cohesive.

[u][b]Graphical Changes[/b][/u]

The graphics in many locations have been changed to look better and more clean. I have also cleaned up a decent amount of graphical clutter, mostly in the overworld sections of the game. There are lots of little touch ups and more will likely be made where the need arises.

I have also made updates to a few of the hero animations for various activities and spells. This includes brand new cutscenes that take place after defeating each of the Archwitches!

[u][b]Balancing[/b][/u]

Many of the enemies throughout the game have had their health and damage values altered to provide better balancing through the game experience.

Health, Magic and Stamina for the hero have also been rebalanced.

[u][b]Miscellaneous[/b][/u]

-New enemy in the graveyard and the Crypt dungeons
-New NPC in the church to explain lore and hint on defeating Zombie enemies
-Boomerang has been changed
    -No longer activates switches
    -Enemy stun time has been reduced slightly
    -Regular boomerang has a trail following it
    -Super boomerang now has a fire trail that can light torches
-Super Gun has been made more frost themed, has potential to turn enemies into ice cubes
-Bombs blow up upon hitting the ground once thrown

I have much more planned for the near future so keep an eye out! Thank you for everyone who has taken an interest in my game so far and hope to see some new faces playing soon! Thanks for reading!

- Kyle

notes.title: Long Steel Update 1.1
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

It's been a while since the last update, but I've been working hard on making some improvements to the game. This comes in the form of various QoL changes, new systems and graphics as well as bug fixes. I'll continue to work hard to improve things as additional feedback is received, but I'm excited for everything coming out with this update.

[u][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/u]
-Softlock following the gangsters toward the beach has been fixed
-Globules will now stack to 30 when you receive the bag upgrade.
-Bridges working as intended.
-Can no longer teleport to the Pale Lands while in the future.
-The miniboss room in the Frozen Castle will no longer lock you in after beating the boss.
-The digging minigame guy is now less adamant that you play his game.
-The torch minigame at the beach now functions correctly.
-Goo is now craftable.
-Falling should now make the hero invincible on respawn for a short time.
-Royal Undercroft softlock has been fixed.
-All books in the library are readable.
-Chest in Frozen Castle no longer respawns keys.
- Various changes have been made to certain functions in the gameplay loop that should prevent crashes. I haven't had an issue with game crashes in my save files so I'm hoping that these changes will help. I would also recommend making sure that all video/graphics drivers are up to date to ensure no issues due to hardware/software.
-Snowman and Bone Skeleton side quests now won't take all your items if you pass the necessary amount.

[u][b]QoL[/b][/u]
-Added an NPC at the Bonfire that will sell reagents for cooking.
-Crafting items have been re-balanced where deemed necessary.
-Enemies have been re-balanced where deemed necessary.
-The Forge of Power has been re-balanced/made less annoying in certain areas.
-Bank money input speed is now sped up while holding down the key.
-Archwitch Luxa's initial laser takes more time before it activates.
-Warlock's clap attack has a slight delay.
-Gaia's jar drop has a slight delay.
-Electric balls while Archwitch Venta is dormant have been removed.
-Ice has been entirely reworked. It is now a regular floor that will make you slip slightly and will make you slip more as your velocity increases gradually.
-Certain puzzles have been reworked.
-Torches that light bridges now stay lit for a longer period of time.
-Side quests that involve talking to certain NPCS/going to certain places now have hints to guide you in the right direction.
-Additional spawning of resources in rooms that require them.
-Jars now have an increased likelihood of dropping certain items when you need them most.
-Rooms that are bright have been darkened and less saturated
-Bullets that blend into the background have been made to be more noticeable.
-Goblin thief enemy has been nerfed.
-Zombie enemy has been nerfed.
-Fruit bushes now have a chance to drop a Mega Fruit which grants additional fruits.
-Jelly blobs now have a chance to drop a Mega Jelly which grants additional jelly.
-The Dash ability has been reworked to be activated by pressing a button.
-Rolling, Looking Far, and Dashing now have their own designated key which can be assigned to whatever suits you most.
-Some maps now have little squirrels that will run into trees when you get too close.
-Rolling into trees now makes a sound and can make leaves fall.
-The Crafting Menus have a new look and the image of the craftable has been increased in size.
-Defeating the pumpkin boss (Jack) now grants an achievement and he will drop his head which can be given to the Pumpkin Witch.

[u][b]Fishing and the Aquarium[/b][/u]

With this update, the way fishing works has been completely changed. You will now cast your line and when a fish bites you will use the Action Key to reel it in. There are 24 different fish and catching them all will give you the Sushi Master achievement. The types of fish you can catch vary depending on your location. There are even some fishing spots in dungeons and fishing spots are guaranteed to spawn on the map rather than being RNG. Fish caught will be placed in the Aquarium near the beach where you can check how many types of fish per location you have left to catch. 

Also, the Golden Fish sidequest will now grant the Golden Rod which makes fish caught worth triple. (i.e. Fish are worth 3 Fish) There is also a hidden map which involves fishing where you can obtain the Golden Shovel. (another new achievement)

[u][b]Galaxus Minigame[/b][/u]

Galaxus, the Shooting Star Knight is now a playable arcade game! Go to the Hoodie Girl's house and there will be an arcade game which you can play for only 5 coins! Battle through waves of enemies and 3 bosses to unlock a new achievement!

[u][b]Trinkets[/b][/u]

I have also added a new little system which I call the Trinket System. There are 9 trinkets in total and each will grant a small extra something to your hero. Stuff like stamina refilling a bit faster, spells costing a bit less mana things like that. The way you obtain these trinkets vary, some are from sidequests or hidden maps that you may have already cleared. In this case, they will be granted to you automatically. Others are brand new and require you to complete new side quests or go to new maps to find them. Collecting them all will grant another new achievement!

[u][b]The Blackened Depths[/b][/u]

The Blackened Depths is a brand new mini dungeons that is only accessible before you head to the future world. This mini dungeon is a dark, cavernous place where dangerous enemies lurk in the shadows. Featuring new enemies and old enemies with a twist, this place is certain to be a challenge. Make it to the end to face a mysterious foe... but where is this place? All we have to go off of is this strange riddle that has been oddly ringing in your head...

"When ashes three are in your hands
Return from where you first began"

I'm not quite sure what this means... but hopefully you can uncover the mystery. 

Well on that note, I hope that everyone enjoys this new update and I will continue to work hard to make Long Steel an even better experience! After dropping this update I'm going to push through a discount of 50% until the end of the Steam Summer Sale as well! Thank you for reading everybody!
